items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The band was a great band, but with Philly Joe in – I never – I sat in with him once.

ctx.x: My Uncle Joe passed away – had passed away for months before me getting kicked out of school. During the dialog between the principal of the school and myself, he said, “And furthermore, your father asked how you were doing in school.” I said, “My father?” “Yes, yes, your father. He’s living in” – what’s the name of that city, near Cincinnati, on the high river? He was in – he was a music teacher in one of these schools. He had asked how I was doing in school, and I guess the principal said, “He’s rotten. We got…
So he had been inquiring about you. You’re talking about your biological father now. Interesting. So when he said to you, your father asked about you . . .
